title: Skeletal Coleus - Mini Plug Plant Houseplant - Rare Unusual Variety
description:
Striking Coleus with delicately cut, fishbone-shaped maroon leaves edged in vibrant lime. Compact, bushy habit; ideal for containers, borders, or as a summer patio plant that can be brought indoors as a houseplant.


 Key Features:


  Variety: Coleus ‘Skeletal’
 

  Habit/Size: Compact; height and spread 30–35 cm
 

  Foliage: Deep maroon with lime-green edging
 

  Use: Bedding, containers, patio, indoor houseplant over winter
 

  Sun/Shade: Sun to part shade (best color in bright indirect light)
 

  Soil: Well-drained, moist, fertile
 

 Care:


  Water: Keep evenly moist; do not waterlog. Let top layer slightly dry between waterings.
 

  Feed: Balanced, water‑soluble feed during growing season (monthly, light).
 

  Pinch: Regularly pinch tips for a bushy plant; remove flower spikes to focus on foliage.
 

  Overwinter: Treat as annual outdoors; take cuttings or bring plants indoors before frost.
